title: The Most Dangerous Element
description:

14:55 Final thoughts

title: iPhone 17 Pro Review: Worth the Upgrade?
description:
The iPhone 17 Pro is here. Camera, battery, display, and the big question — should you upgrade from last year?

In this review I cover:
• Design and build quality
• Camera samples in daylight and low light
• Battery life over a full workday
• Performance and thermals
• Who should upgrade — and who should wait

Full sample gallery and unedited clips are on the website. Music by Approaching Nirvana. This video is not sponsored.

#apple #iphone #techreview

description:

title: I Built a $50,000 Gaming PC
description:

Build list (affiliate links in description):

title: The Banach–Tarski Paradox
description:
How can you cut a ball into pieces and reassemble them into two balls the same size as the original?

This paradox asks: can you take a solid ball, cut it into finitely many pieces, and reassemble them into two balls identical to the original?

We’ll talk about infinite sets, non-measurable pieces, and why mathematicians still argue about the axioms underneath.

Further watching: related Vsauce episodes on infinity and the Banach–Tarski follow-ups.

#math #paradox #vsauce
